Inbox._comment: The Gmail account to READ. Use a Gmail App Password (not your normal password). Turn on 2-Step Verification, then create an App Password at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords. Put the real values in appsettings.Local.json (git-ignored).

Delivery._comment: Where the daily summary email is sent FROM and TO. SenderEmail also needs a Gmail App Password.

Schedule._comment: DailyRunTime is 24-hour local time HH:mm. RunImmediatelyOnStart sends one digest right away when the agent starts (useful for testing).

Classification._comment: Keyword rules used to keep interview/placement emails and drop spam/promotions. Case-insensitive substring match against subject + body + sender.

OpenAi._comment: Optional ChatGPT summaries. Put the real ApiKey in appsettings.Local.json (git-ignored) or a Render env var OpenAi__ApiKey. Leave empty to use the free keyword summary. gpt-4o-mini is cheap and fast.
